policy.work_crs_reason: Local metre-based WGS84 / UTM zone 45N candidate for the supplied Nepal-border source grid and DEM; not a final area-of-use decision for all regional 200 km data.
policy.datum_operation: Use pyproj TransformerGroup and record selected operation, accuracy and ballpark flag. Unknown accuracy/ballpark is permitted only for exploratory coverage; no survey-grade positional claim.

geometry.planar_analysis: Force geometry copies to 2D; source Z values remain unchanged in originals and have no verified vertical semantics.
geometry.invalid_geometry: Use make_valid on derived copies only and record counts; no source edits.
geometry.intersection: Shapely projected planar geometry intersection after source-edge densification; area in square metres. Raster valid coverage separately measured from native pixel masks.

dem.vertical_datum: unknown; no vertical datum transformation performed
dem.warning: 30 m target sampling does not imply improved native spatial resolution, verified event-time terrain or a hydrologically corrected DEM.

netcdf.geotiff_orientation: x increasing and y decreasing; reverse arrays with coordinates when necessary
netcdf.warning: NC glacier mask is a source-parameter grid reference, not an independently confirmed 2026 failure polygon.

landcover.classes: Retain numeric codes; names and product legend unverified
landcover.sample_support: All positive NC glacier-mask cell centres transformed with formal pyproj; corresponding native raster cell is sampled. Also warp a nearest-neighbour NC-grid sample.

corridor.result: Source-grid local validity can be measured. Source-to-port channel continuity remains unverified until both endpoints and channel path have traceable evidence.

human_review_required: Confirm true event source polygon and port protection-point coordinates with traceable evidence.
Supply independently supported river centreline or DEM-derived network validated against imagery, then test buffered whole-path coverage.
Confirm DEM product, date, vertical datum and error before physical slope, routing or volume interpretation.
Assess CGCS2000 datum-operation accuracy requirement; ballpark transformation is not a precision geodetic result.
Confirm land-cover legend and obtain source-region valid categories before using class codes as features.
policy.ai_assistance: OpenAI Codex prepared this preprocessing policy and script; team members must review adoption and modifications in AI_USAGE.md.

attrs_after_decoding.description: Ice thickness data from A consensus estimate for the ice thickness distribution of all glaciers on Earth (Farinotti et al., 2019).
climatological [2014-2024] vx determined by a weighted least squares line fit, described by an offset and slope, to mean annual vx values. The climatology uses a time-intercept of January 1, 2018.
climatological [2014-2024] mean seasonal amplitude of sinusoidal fit to vx
climatological [2014-2024] vy determined by a weighted least squares line fit, described by an offset and slope, to mean annual vy values. The climatology uses a time-intercept of January 1, 2018.
climatological [2014-2024] mean seasonal amplitude in sinusoidal fit in vy
determined by taking the hypotenuse of vx and vy. The climatology uses a time-intercept of January 1, 2018.
climatological [2014-2024] mean seasonal amplitude in the direction of mean flow as defined by vx and vy
Glacier mask derived from the Randolph Glacier Inventory 6.0 (combining RGI60-15.04172, RGI60-15.04173, RGI60-15.04174, and RGI60-15.04175)
